name: skill-forge
description: Turn an already-completed workflow into a tested, evidence-backed Agent Skill, with trigger tests, an eight-gate quality scorecard, and Claude Code / Codex packaging.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a finished workflow into a tested, publish-ready Agent Skill
interface.longDescription: Skill Forge harvests evidence from the current session, git history, and project files, distills it into a portable procedure, scores it against eight quality gates, and packages the result for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and skills.sh.
